Bar chart does not display for one column data if there is a '.' in the column name

### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Bar chart does not display for one column data if there is a '.' in the column name.

### Reproducible Code Example

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-7714)

```Python
import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st
import numpy as np

st.title("This works")
chart_data = pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(20, 3), columns=["a", "b", "c"])
st.bar_chart(chart_data)

st.title("This works")
chart_data = pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(20, 3), columns=["a.b", "b.c", "c.d"])
st.bar_chart(chart_data)

st.title("This works")
chart_data = pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(20, 1), columns=["a"])
st.bar_chart(chart_data)

st.title("This doesn't work")
chart_data = pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(20, 1), columns=["a.b"])
st.bar_chart(chart_data)
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Run this
2. Note the cases which do and do not display a graph

### Expected Behavior

There should be four graphs.

### Current Behavior

There are only three being displayed properly.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.28.1
- Python version: 3.10.12
- Operating System: 5.15.0-88-generic #98-Ubuntu
- Browser: Chrome Version 119.0.6045.123 (Official Build) (arm64)


### Additional Information

I suspect that there is somewhere in the code confusing the '.' in the column name for the dot operator. I expect that '.'s need to be escaped. Not sure why this only happens with one column and not with multiple columns.
